subject: Request: SLA carveout & pilot commercial terms - Provisioning.io
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@provisioning.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@provisioning.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request - SLA carveout & commercial asks

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our team is ready to run a 6-month on-demand pilot with Redwood but we have two constraints from our infra team that require non-standard SLA terms:

- We need the uptime target for the pilot to be 99.5% (vs your standard 99.95%) due to multi-tenant scheduling during onboarding.
- We also need a firm cap on service credits (we can accept a cap equal to three months of projected consumption or a hard-dollar cap).

Commercially, we are asking for a one-time onboarding discount (20% off committed spend for first 6 months) and a staging window to test scale. We understand this is outside standard terms and are open to mitigation (dedicated tenant, restricted traffic windows) if that helps.

I attached a short requirements sheet for the pilot (Provisioning_POC_requirements.pdf). Please let me know the fastest path to get legal/exec alignment so we can start by August.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Cloud Operations
Provisioning.io

Attachment: Provisioning_POC_requirements.pdf
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot request - SLA carveout & commercial asks

Marissa / Lauren — forwarding Provisioning's ask. Quick summary and recommended guardrails below. We need an exec-level decision because this impacts SLA precedent and potential credit exposure.

What they want:
- Uptime: 99.5% for a 6-month pilot (vs our 99.95% standard)
- Cap on service credits: they asked for 3 months consumption or a hard cap
- 20% onboarding discount for first 6 months

My recommended mitigations:
1) Approve a timeboxed 6-month concession to 99.5% only for the pilot.
2) Cap credits at $40k OR 2 months of invoiced consumption (whichever is lower).
3) Approve a one-time onboarding discount at 12% (not 20%) tied to a committed minimum spend.
4) Require a dedicated tenant + KMS integration + audit log access during pilot.
5) Add a rollback clause: after pilot, revert to standard SLA unless expanded contract signed.

If you approve, I'll send the amendment language to the customer and route to Legal + Finance for signoff. If you want to increase the credit cap or discount, flag for Lauren's exec sign-off.

Thanks,
Sergio
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot request - SLA carveout & commercial asks

Sergio — thanks for the write-up and proposed mitigations. A couple of quick asks from my side before we escalate:

- Can you confirm projected invoiced spend for the pilot (monthly expected run-rate)? I modeled exposure for a $25k/month pilot but need confirmation.
- Please attach a one-pager cost/credit sensitivity (I added a stub: deal_summary.xlsx).

Commercial stance: I'm comfortable recommending the timeboxed SLA concession but prefer a lower discount — 10% seems more supportable given the operational overhead.

Legal/Proc: will want the credit cap expressed as a hard-dollar amount or a formula tied to invoiced spend. Also request S&M to require the dedicated tenant and security checklist before we finalize.

If Lauren greenlights anything >$25k credit exposure or >15% discount, we should route to Exec.

Marissa
VP, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

Attachment: deal_summary.xlsx
Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/Provisioning.io
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot request - SLA carveout & commercial asks

On Wed, Jul 14, 2027 at 3:00 PM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Sergio — thanks for the write-up and proposed mitigations. A couple of quick asks from my side before we escalate:
> ...

Team — after reviewing the inputs, I will approve a conditional carveout for the pilot under the following firm conditions:

1) Term: 6-month pilot only; SLA reverts to standard 99.95% after pilot unless we sign a full contract amendment.
2) Uptime: Accept temporary 99.5% for the pilot.
3) Credit cap: Hard cap = $40,000 OR two months of invoiced consumption (whichever is lower).
4) Discount: Approve a one-time onboarding discount of 12% applied to committed spend for the first 6 months.
5) Security/Infra: Customer must sign off on dedicated tenant, KMS integration, and provide access to audit logs before pilot start. Security to validate via checklist.
6) Document: Legal to prepare an addendum with an explicit rollback clause and credit calculation examples.

Finance/Rev Rec: Marissa / Aditya, please confirm revenue recognition/GL treatment for the 12% concession and the exposure for the $40k cap. If this exceeds allowable tolerance, escalate to CFO.

Once Legal prepares the addendum, route to Exec for signature. I've attached an internal stub of the approval to include in the redline packet.

Approved by: Lauren Bishop
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: approved_sla_addendum_stub.pdf
Link: https://docusign.com/xyz/Provisioning_Addendum
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@provisioning.io>
Cc: Procurement <procure@provisioning.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot request - SLA carveout & commercial asks

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the requirements doc. Per internal review, we can agree to a timeboxed pilot with the following outbound summary (see Lauren's approval below):

- Uptime: 99.5% for a 6-month pilot (pilot window only).
- Credit cap: $40,000 OR two months of invoiced consumption (whichever is lower).
- Discount: 12% onboarding discount applied to committed spend for the first 6 months.
- Security pre-reqs: dedicated tenant, KMS integration, audit logs available to your security team before pilot start.
- Rollback: SLA reverts to standard 99.95% at pilot end unless we execute a full amendment.

I've attached the initial addendum for signature (SLA_Addendum_v1.pdf). Legal will ship a redline copy; please review and return to me so we can route via DocuSign.

Next steps:
1) Confirm expected monthly run-rate so we can finalize the credit cap formula.
2) Security to confirm readiness on the dedicated tenant.
3) Legal to complete addendum and send for signatures (link above).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Sergio Alvarez
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SLA_Addendum_v1.pdf
